name: budget-guard
description: Tracks estimated token usage per tool call. Warns Claude at configurable thresholds so you never hit context limits by surprise. Shows a real-time breakdown by tool category.

session_budget.title: Session token budget
session_budget.description: Estimated max tokens per session. Claude Pro ≈ 100,000 | Max ≈ 200,000

warn_threshold.title: Warning threshold (%)
warn_threshold.description: Show an advisory warning to Claude at this % of budget used. Default: 60.

critical_threshold.title: Critical threshold (%)
critical_threshold.description: Show a critical warning at this %. Default: 85.
